title: 酒盒/礼盒大面积烫金发花、有砂眼怎么办？

seo.title: 酒盒/礼盒大面积烫金发花、有砂眼怎么办？

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答“酒盒、礼盒、化妆品盒大面积烫金为什么发花、有砂眼、局部缺金？”这类高价值包装场景问题。

## Reddit 英文短评版

Large solid foil areas are much harder than small logos.

Patchy foil or pinholes can come from uneven pressure, rough paper, dust, spray powder, unstable temperature or a foil grade that is not made for solid coverage. I would test a solid block and fine text on the same sheet before approving any foil for production.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Large-area foil stamping requires a different evaluation method from small logo stamping.

If a small logo looks good but a large solid area is cloudy or patchy, the issue may be related to pressure uniformity, substrate smoothness, foil metallization uniformity or adhesive layer performance under a large contact area.

I would check:

1. Die flatness

1. Sheet surface cleanliness

1. Paper coating uniformity

1. Pressure balance across the stamping area

1. Foil tension

1. Temperature stability

1. Whether the foil is designed for solid-area transfer

A proper test should include a full solid block, not only the customer logo. For wine boxes, rigid boxes and premium gift packaging, a high-gloss solid-area foil grade is often required.

## 知乎中文科普版

大面积烫金和小logo烫金不是一个难度。

小logo能烫好，不代表大面积一定稳定。酒盒、礼盒大面积烫金容易发花、有砂眼，常见原因包括：

1. 纸张表面不平。

1. 压力不均匀。

1. 模具平整度不够。

1. 温度不稳定。

1. 纸面有喷粉、灰尘或油污。

1. 烫金膜不适合大面积实地转移。

所以酒盒礼盒打样时，不能只拿一个小logo测试。一定要加大面积实地图案、细线、小字和反白字。只有这些都稳定，才能说明这款膜适合量产。

## 阿里国际站成交版

For large-area foil stamping on wine boxes or gift boxes, we suggest using a foil grade designed for solid-area coverage.

Patchy transfer or pinholes may be caused by uneven pressure, rough paper surface, dust, unstable temperature or unsuitable foil grade.

We can provide high-gloss metallic foil samples for large-area stamping. Please send your paper board sample and artwork size, and we will help recommend the right grade.

## 自然 CTA

We can provide high-gloss solid-area foil samples, color cards and test rolls before bulk production.

## 关键词

large area foil stamping, patchy foil stamping, wine box hot stamping foil, gift box foil, 酒盒烫金发花, 礼盒大面积烫金, 烫金砂眼
